prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: A sturgeon and a pike. Once a sturgeon and a pike quarelled. The pike bit the sturgeon with its sharp teeth. She immediately sailed back. It is not easy to bite a sturgeon. Now the pike was laughing, scaring all the fish: "I'm the strongest pike." The sturgeon understood that it cheated the fishes. The sturgeon started fighting with the pike. The sturgeon beats the pike with its rough body. It hurts the pike. It got afraid and ran away. Then the sturgeon shot an arrow from a bow at the pike. A sharp arrow hit the pike's back. Now the pike's bones diverge on two sides.
